command: set -eu; SVC=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; OLD=2720334; CUR=$(systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p MainPID --value); test "$CUR" = "$OLD"; test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$SVC")" = active; test -z "$(pgrep -P "$CUR" || true)"; if ss -tpn 2>/dev/null | grep -q "pid=$CUR,"; then echo 'ACTIVE_SOCKET_PRESENT'; exit 31; fi; journalctl --user -u "$SVC" --since '-90 sec' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'gespraech.aktiv=0 -- pausiert'; PROD=/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts; grep -q 'world_patch.install(sys.modules\[__name__\])' "$PROD/voice_full_runtime.py"; test -f "$PROD/omega_voice_world_patch.py"; echo "OLD_PID=$CUR"; echo SAFE_IDLE_BOUNDARY=PASS; systemctl --user restart "$SVC"; for i in $(seq 1 30); do STATE=$(systemctl --user is-active "$SVC" 2>/dev/null || true); NEW=$(systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$STATE" = active ] && [ -n "$NEW" ] && [ "$NEW" != 0 ] && [ "$NEW" != "$OLD" ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done; test "$STATE" = active; test "$NEW" != 0; test "$NEW" != "$OLD"; RAW=$(systemctl --user show "$SVC" -p ExecStart --value); case "$RAW" in *'/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py'*) ;; *) echo "BAD_EXEC=$RAW"; exit 32;; esac; sleep 1; test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$SVC")" = active; RECENT=$(journalctl --user -u "$SVC" --since '-30 sec' --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true); printf '%s\n' "$RECENT" | tail -40; printf '%s\n' "$RECENT" | grep -q 'gespraech.aktiv=0 -- pausiert'; echo "NEW_PID=$NEW"; echo 'GESTPRAECH_AKTIV_REMAINS=0'; echo 'FINAL_WORLD_BRAIN_PROCESS_LOADED=PASS'; echo 'LIFECYCLE_ACTIVATION=PASS'
